name: Marble Mountains
kicker: The marble hill on the Hoi An road
summary: Climb Thuy Son, the marble hill on the road you are already taking toward Hoi An. Caves, pagodas, and a lookout are the morning. Adults pay 40,000 VND for the hill. The elevator and Am Phu cave are separate, and the other peaks are how a transfer morning falls apart.
getThere: 81 Huyen Tran Cong Chua, about 15 minutes from the center. Hoi An is about 30 minutes further.
heroCaption: The marble cliff above the town at its foot

notice.title: Am Phu is a second ticket
notice.body: Thuy Son is 40,000 VND. Am Phu cave is another 20,000 VND for an adult. The elevator is extra too. Buy the hill, and stop, if Hoi An is the rest of the day.

body: Climb Thuy Son. The range has six peaks, and the tourism portal points visitors at this one. Inside the hill are caves, Tam Thai pagoda, Linh Ung on the hill, and lookouts over the coast. The portal suggests about 3 to 4 hours if you take the fuller morning.

Tickets are at Gate 01 or Gate 02. Adults pay 40,000 VND for Thuy Son. Students pay 10,000 VND. Children under 6 are free. The elevator is 15,000 VND one way and 30,000 VND return. Am Phu cave is a second ticket: 20,000 VND for an adult, 7,000 VND for a student, free under 6.

The hill sits at 81 Huyen Tran Cong Chua, about 8 kilometers and about 15 minutes from the center, on the way to Hoi An. From the hills to Hoi An by the coastal road is about 30 minutes. Non Nuoc, the carving village at the foot, has no ticket on the city list. Walk it only if the hill did not already take the morning.

figures.caption: The stair inside Huyen Khong cave
figures.alt: A stone stair inside a Marble Mountains cave, with painted guardians on both sides

gettingThere: The hills are in Ngu Hanh Son ward, southeast of the center, on the coast road toward Hoi An. Go by car or Grab. The tourism portal gives 81 Huyen Tran Cong Chua, about 8 kilometers, about 15 minutes from the center, and about 30 minutes on from the hills to Hoi An.

legs.heading: From Da Nang
legs.body: About 15 minutes by road from the center, on the city tourism portal. The address is 81 Huyen Tran Cong Chua.

legs.heading: Toward Hoi An
legs.body: The same portal says about 30 minutes from the hills to Hoi An by the coastal road. Do the hill first if both are the same morning.

closed: No weekly closing day is published. Check the gate.
admissionNote: Thuy Son: adults 40,000 VND, students 10,000 VND, children under 6 free. Elevator: 15,000 VND one way, 30,000 VND return. Am Phu cave: adults 20,000 VND, students 7,000 VND, under 6 free. The 2026 tourism price list and the Marble Mountains page give these figures. Tickets are at Gate 01 or Gate 02.
